$comment: Options for audit-rendered.mjs under the clarity design. Clarity draws every action button filled; navigation entries (menu rows, rail buttons, phone tabs, a tab strip's scroll arrows) mark the current place by their ground and a table head's sort control is part of the head, a dashboard card's rows (the task and attention rows) are list rows drawn like the menu rows, and a chart legend's entries are the legend's keys whose mark says whether the series is shown, so those stand bare by design. A dashboard's cards stand side by side in a grid, each a panel with its own heading, so the grid is a collection of panels and never a row of figures (recordCollectionSelector). A time range strip draws its window as a rounded badge with a calendar glyph, which is a control of the strip and never a message (notAMessageSelector, the audit default plus the strip). The fill rule applies only to a page that draws a console shell slot (buttonFillScope), because another kit may share the design name.
